messages.content: Recommend exactly one new discrete peptide amino-acid sequence to minimize the measured APEX bacteria_0 MIC. Lower MIC is better. Use the good, bad, and recent valid evaluated peptides as evidence; do not invent measured results. Return exactly one JSON object with the single key "sequence", for example {"sequence":"AKLR"}. Return no explanation, batch, latent vector, or 3D coordinates. The example is only a format example and must also meet the real task constraints before being proposed.
